title: デビュー戦の後に・ホープの始動

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki dazzles everyone with her performance on the track. In the press conference afterward, she declares her intention to become a Triple Crown Champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone is sent into an excited flurry by her words. All are watching her expectantly as she heads toward the Asahi Hai F.S.
